analysis:
Reviewed all 18 units. The PR is a docs and tooling cleanup after console-ui moved to darkbloom-platform. It touches CONTRIBUTING.md, README.md, docs/AGENTS.md, docs/README.md, the Makefile and a new changelog fragment. No Swift provider code, protocol, crypto, attestation, cache-storage or fan-helper code changed. This leaves the provider threat entries untouched: TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009, TB-010, TB-011, TB-012, T-041 and the App Attest entries.

Makefile (head lines 4-6, 95-103): the ui-* targets are removed and the test, build and clean aggregates no longer reference console-ui. Provider, landing, docs-check, changelog-check and benchmark-wrapper-test remain in the aggregates, so no security-relevant test or check is dropped from the provider path. The provider-test target (head lines 20-28) is unchanged, so protocol fixture and metallib staging checks remain.

README.md line 67 now describes coordinator/tests/protocol/testdata/ as shared protocol fixtures. The reference/protocol-messages.md mirror and the provider resource readers are not shown. This is a docs matter, not a security regression.

The changelog fragment states that the .githooks pre-commit and pre-push hooks, the CI lane and the Dependabot entry were removed. Those files are not in this batch, so their removal could not be examined. Possible loss of a CI lint or secret-scan control in those hooks is unverified. Dependabot removal covers only the console npm ecosystem as described. Other ecosystems for the provider and landing are not shown, so this needs a check against the full PR file list.

No new attack surface, trust-boundary change or invalidated threat assumption is visible in the supplied evidence.
